channel.description: Latest articles from Cityside Journalism Initiative (berkeleyside.org)

item.title: The Wire: Huge fire destroys West Berkeley warehouse
item.description: Also: Hundreds protest ICE at UC Berkeley, and dangerous conditions in a student housing co-op.

item.title: Berkeley teen helps fund children’s library for families in Turkey displaced by 2023 earthquake
item.description: A fundraiser through the nonprofit Bridge to Turkey Fund aims to raise $5,000 by March to support expansion of the library space.

item.title: Situationship? Married for decades? Where to dine on Valentine’s Day in the East Bay — based on your relationship
item.description: From couples who just started dating to those decades past “I do,” Nosh has a holiday spot for you.

item.title: Get a first look at the massive Tokyo Central opening in Emeryville
item.description: Everything you need to know about the grand opening for the 44,000-square-foot grocery and restaurant on Saturday, Jan. 31.

item.title: Two police oversight board members resign in protest, saying Berkeley ignores its work
item.description: The resignations of Kitty Calavita and Julie Leftwich leave the nine-seat Police Accountability Board with just four members.

item.title: Berkeley businesses close, students protest as city joins ‘ICE Out’ national strike
item.description: Cheese Board Collective, Nabolom Bakery and the climbing gym Berkeley Ironworks were among the businesses closed in solidarity with the "no work, no school, no shopping" protest.

item.title: Berkeley’s Flow Lounge is a hip-hop incubator and community builder
item.description: The weekly event, held at Club Cali and hosted by Hip-Hop For the Future, provides a space where MCs can write new work live and perform for a receptive audience.

item.title: Berkeley could loosen rules on pepper spray, tear gas and other police gear
item.description: A City Council committee approved a proposal to reduce reporting requirements when police officers use pepper spray. It will soon consider other changes to loosen limits on whether officers can deploy tear gas and other weapons, and when they can ask for helicopters and police dogs.

item.title: Will ICE be at the Super Bowl?
item.description: As Santa Clara prepares to host Super Bowl LX, anxieties about possible ICE presence in the Bay Area have grown. What do we actually know?

item.title: Kehlani, former Berkeley student, wins first Grammy and calls out ICE
item.description: The former Berkeley High transfer student won twice for the hit song “Folded.”
